enemy-settings.label: Minimap label per team
enemy-names.body:
Determines when vehicle names of enemy tanks are displayed:
- Only on ALT - only while ALT is pressed,
- Hide on ALT - visible without ALT, hidden with ALT (default),
- Always - vehicle names are always displayed,
- Never - vehicle names are never displayed.
ally-names.body:
Determines when vehicle names of allied tanks are displayed:
- Only on ALT - hidden without ALT, visible with ALT (default),
- Hide on ALT - visible without ALT, hidden with ALT,
- Always - vehicle names are always displayed,
- Never - vehicle names are never displayed.
squad-names.body:
Determines when squad members are labeled (same 4 modes as for
enemies and allies):
- Only on ALT - only while ALT is pressed,
- Hide on ALT - visible without ALT, hidden with ALT,
- Always - always visible (default),
- Never - squad members are never labeled.

The name shown is chosen in the two dropdowns below:
'Without ALT' and 'With ALT' - player name or vehicle name.
squad-names-no-alt.header: Squad member label variable Without ALT
squad-names-no-alt.body:
Name shown for squad members while ALT is not pressed:
- Username - the player name (default),
- Vehicle - the vehicle name.
squad-names-alt.header: Squad member label variable With ALT key
squad-names-alt.body:
Name shown for squad members while ALT is pressed:
- Username - the player name,
- Vehicle - the vehicle name (default).
mark-enemy-squads.body:
Marks platoon members on the red team with a star. You can choose the star position in the dropdown below:
- *Name - star before the name,
- *Name* - star on both sides,
- Name* - star after the name.
enemy-squad-star-position.body: Controls where the star is displayed on enemy platoon vehicle names.
